name: Grilled Salmon with Curried Yogurt Sauce & Pickled Cucumber Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 English cucumbers
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup white wine vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice the cucumbers and add to the bowl.
Peel and thinly slice the red onion; add to the bowl with the cucumber and toss to coat.
Juice lemons into a medium bowl. Add yogurt and spices; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 ½ tsp curry powder
¾ tsp turmeric
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg salmon fillet
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the grill pan or skillet is hot, drizzle with oil and add fillets. Working on batches if necessary, grill until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cucumber salad; toss to combine.
To serve, divide rice, salmon, and cucumber salad between plates. Serve with curried yogurt sauce and enjoy!
